title: Kalshi Events Catalog
description: Catalogs all active events on Kalshi with their associated market count, total volume, and category. Events group related binary markets - e.g., 'Fed Rate Decision March 2026' contains markets for each possible rate outcome. Tracks which categories (Economics, Weather, Politics, Finance) are seeing the most trading activity. Useful for identifying where institutional attention is concentrating.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2'
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

rows = []
cursor = None

for page in range(5):
    params = {'limit': 200, 'status': 'active'}
    if cursor:
        params['cursor'] = cursor

    resp = requests.get(f'{BASE}/events', params=params, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    events = data.get('events', [])
    if not events:
        break

    for ev in events:
        markets = ev.get('markets', [])
        market_count = len(markets) if markets else int(ev.get('market_count', 0) or 0)

        total_volume = 0
        total_oi = 0
        if markets:
            for mk in markets:
                total_volume = total_volume + int(mk.get('volume', 0) or 0)
                total_oi = total_oi + int(mk.get('open_interest', 0) or 0)

        rows.append({
            'event_ticker': ev.get('event_ticker', ''),
            'title': ev.get('title', ''),
            'category': ev.get('category', ''),
            'sub_title': ev.get('sub_title', ''),
            'market_count': market_count,
            'total_volume': total_volume,
            'total_open_interest': total_oi,
            'status': ev.get('status', 'active'),
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

    cursor = data.get('cursor', '')
    if not cursor:
        break
    time.sleep(0.1)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('total_volume', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
